Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES

Topic 11.1: Pool safety SWIMMING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pool safety SWIMMING. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
